description: Rewrite every programming-language Coding Rules source in natural American English without creating localized copies. The complete GDScript rules and all language stubs must retain their technical constraints and installation paths.
acceptance_criteria: Every file under coding-rules-library/languages uses English canonical prose
GDScript typing naming lambda resource and error-handling rules retain their technical meaning
CSharp TypeScript Python Rust and generic stubs remain clearly actionable
Bootstrap can continue copying the same stable file paths
notes: Human review confirmed all acceptance criteria on 2026-08-26. All six stable programming-language Coding Rules sources now use canonical English: the generic, C#, Python, Rust, and TypeScript files remain explicit actionable stubs, while GDScript remains a complete field-tested rules source. Regression coverage locks the exact file set, English-only prose, every stub heading and actionable TODO clause, stable Bootstrap installation paths, and detailed GDScript invariants and typed examples. Fresh-context review corrected Godot 4 setter behavior, non-debug assert evaluation, typed signals and examples, Node/Object reference equality, and Godot 4.3 static-variable lifecycle guidance. Static state is documented as process-local across Scene changes; Autoload provides explicit global ownership and serialized Resources or files provide persistence across runs. Code smell scan: pass (feature: F015, must_fix: 0, suggest: 0, acceptable: 3).
